ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite monitoring platform using time-series geospatial analysis to track illegal logging and land encroachment in British Columbia's protected forests.
ideas.title: PacificForest-ATLAS
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-performing GeoNex-ATLAS pattern by applying satellite intelligence to a local environmental pain point that resonates strongly with Vancouver judges.

ideas.pitch: Hyper-local coordination app that groups elderly or mobility-impaired residents in Vancouver with vetted student volunteer drivers for grocery runs and medical appointments.
ideas.title: BC-Transit-Match
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the grand-prize winning formula of the Outreach app by targeting a clear, compassionate social need with a localized community impact.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent supply-chain and matching engine that predicts restaurant food surplus in Vancouver and coordinates instant volunteer pickup to local shelters.
ideas.title: VanFood-Rescue-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines predictive data modeling with a measurable, quantified social and environmental benefit that local hackathon judges immediately care about.

ideas.pitch: No-code automated trading strategy builder optimized for perpetual DEXs, featuring backtesting against historical crypto market volatility in the Pacific time zone.
ideas.title: PacificPerp-Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning ClashX template by delivering a polished, high-utility financial tool with complex backtesting built within a tight sprint.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven patient intake and trust engine tailored for local British Columbian dental and orthodontic clinics to automate consultations and patient acquisition.
ideas.title: Clinique-Smile-BC
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven Global-Smile prize-winning model to solve a real, revenue-driving problem familiar to local small-business healthcare providers.
